description: Ralph Pipeline 01 - Foundation: schema, sync core, one-shot sync, sidecar emit for surfacing Ralph pipeline state to the overview-viewer dashboard via a generated sidecar (plans/overview-ralph-state.{js,json}).

planReviewContext.description: Group artifacts (.ralph/job-groups/<group>/group.json) have no derivable RalphStage. `groupState` is a parameter to deriveRalphStage, and sync-core's cross-kind precedence allows `group` to win over `brainstorm`, but no predicate in the table consumes `groupState`. A group-only match has no defined stage and cannot satisfy the '10 stage cases' acceptance criterion. Either drop `groupState` from the bundle, add explicit group-derived stages, or define group->stage roll-up rules in sync-core (e.g., use the dominant member's stage).
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Group artifacts are read via their own top-level job-state.json/prd.json/findings (same schema as jobs); the existing 10-case predicate covers them. Drop the unused groupState parameter from the predicate signature and ambient decl; add a group-as-job acceptance-criterion test case.

planReviewContext.description: The `planning` predicate (#8) is not derivable under the declared `deriveRalphStage` signature. Predicate #8 needs a `jobDir-exists` marker when both prd.json and job-state.json are absent. Neither the runtime signature nor the scripts.d.ts declaration carries that marker. Add a `jobDirMarker?: true` field to the bundle, or move the `planning` decision into sync-core.
planReviewContext.suggestedFix: Add jobDirMarker?: true to the deriveRalphStage bundle (scripts.d.ts + JSDoc), rewrite predicate #8 to test the marker, and assign sync-core the responsibility of setting it when a jobDir/groupDir is observed without prd.json or job-state.json.

userStories.title: Walk + match + cross-kind collapse (sync-core walkRalphState)
userStories.description: As a sync orchestrator, I want a deterministic walk of .ralph/ that resolves artifacts to overview task IDs and collapses cross-kind collisions before predicate evaluation.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/lib/sync-core.mjs exports walkRalphState({ repoRoot, config, generatedFromCommit }) -> Promise<OverviewRalphState>
Walk root is exactly <repoRoot>/<config.ralphRoot>/; walker NEVER recurses from <repoRoot> directly (would hit .worktrees/*/.ralph/)

Walk reads direct children of <ralphRoot>/<ralphSubdirs.jobs>/ (job-state.json, prd.json, code-review-findings.json, docs-review-findings.json), <ralphRoot>/<ralphSubdirs.jobGroups>/ (top-level job-state.json/prd.json/findings + group.json metadata), <ralphRoot>/<ralphSubdirs.brainstorms>/ (brainstorm.json); sets jobDirMarker: true when <slug>/ or <group>/ observed; does NOT recurse into <slug>/

Skips symlinks; skips paths matching any pattern in config.watcher.ignored (minimum: .worktrees/**, **/.git/**, .ralph/jobs/*/worktree/**, .ralph/jobs/.staging/**, .ralph/telemetry/**, .crews/logs/**, .crews/spawn-launchers/**)
Nested <jobGroups>/<group>/<member>/job-state.json files do NOT produce per-task entries (group-member granularity is Plan 10)

Slug-heuristic matching resolves each artifact to OverviewTask.id: (1) ralphOverrides[slug] -> matchSource: 'override'; (2) OverviewTask.id === slug -> matchSource: 'slug-default'; (3) otherwise append to unmatched[] with reason: 'no-matching-task-id'
Within-kind duplicates: pick max jobState.updatedAt (fallback to directory mtime); losers -> unmatched[] with reason: 'duplicate-resolution'
Cross-kind precedence: job > group > brainstorm; losers -> unmatched[] with reason: 'shadowed-by-<winning-kind>'; precedence applied BEFORE predicate; winner's bundle is what deriveRalphStage sees
Malformed job-state.json: log to stderr, append to unmatched[] with reason: 'parse-error', do NOT derive a stage from sibling files for that slug (per F-011)
reviewOpenCount.<phase> is undefined (NOT 0) when the corresponding findings file is missing
Output is deterministically sorted: byTaskId keys alphabetical; unmatched[] sorted by kind then slug
Sync-core stamps generatedFromCommit (passed by CLI) and generatedAt = new Date().toISOString() onto returned state
walkRalphState does NOT shell out to git (CLI owns git rev-parse)
Helper exports resolveCrossKindPrecedence and pickMostRecentByMtime for unit testing (signatures in scripts.d.ts)

Unit tests cover: cross-kind precedence (job shadows brainstorm), duplicate-by-mtime within one kind, malformed-JSON skip (asserts reason: 'parse-error' in unmatched[]), slug-default vs ralphOverrides resolution, group-as-job stage derivation
